title: Where does the critical plane sit?
intro: Each point of the sphere is a material plane, identified by its normal. The colour is the Findley damage parameter on that plane for combined axial and torsional loading. Change the shear-to-normal amplitude ratio and the phase shift, and watch the critical planes move.
hover_empty: Point at the sphere to read DP/σa
drag: Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate.
label: Findley damage parameter on the unit sphere of plane normals, λ = %l, Δφ = %p°, maximum DP/σa = %d.
provenance: Computed with multifat (multiaxial-fatigue) at commit %commit%: evaluate_findley with MCC shear amplitude, one call per plane on a %step%° grid, k = %k%. Loading: σxx = σa sin ωt, τxy = λσa sin(ωt − Δφ), zero mean. Illustrative coefficient, not a material calibration.
